one_line: Seuna Yadava ruler who pushed east into Telangana, capturing but then reinstating Ganapati Deva as a frontier subordinate.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, lean but hard-trained build, athletic rather than bulky.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; eyes sharp and slightly angled, default expression calm and assessing, with a faint, confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a short, tidy topknot at the crown; sides smooth and close to the head; a narrow gold band circling the forehead beneath the knot, with a small central round red gemstone set above the brows.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 12th-century Deccan royal-warrior attire: a fitted, sleeveless quilted cotton tunic (angarkha-style) reaching mid-thigh in muted deep maroon, fastened diagonally with simple toggles; over this, a dull-bronze scale vest (small overlapping metal scales) covering chest and upper back, tied with leather cords; beneath, cream-coloured tight-fitting churidar-style trousers with fine, subtle vertical stripe weave; a long, soft cotton sash in mustard yellow wraps firmly around his waist and knots on the left hip, the end hanging to knee level; over one shoulder, a light greyish-blue cotton rajapatta-style scarf draped diagonally across the torso and back, its border decorated with a thin maroon and gold geometric trim; on his feet, brown leather paduka-like sandals with covered uppers instead of bare straps; forearms protected with simple brown leather bracers, slightly worn; minimal jewellery: small gold hoop earrings, a single thin gold bangle on his right wrist, and a flat, circular copper pendant on a cord at his neck.
appearance.signature: A long Deccan-style steel sword with a gently curved single-edged blade, a simple iron disc-shaped pommel, and a straight crossguard; the grip wrapped in dark brown leather, carried in a plain dark leather scabbard slung from his left hip and held in his right hand when posed.

ref_desc: Jaitugi Yadava is a late-30s lean warrior king with medium-brown complexion, short beard, black topknot and gold headband, wearing a deep maroon tunic, dull-bronze scale vest, cream trousers, mustard sash, greyish-blue scarf and carrying a curved Deccan sword at his hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Jaitugi Yadava: a late-30s lean Deccan warrior king with medium-brown skin, oval face, high cheekbones, straight nose, sharp eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache. His thick black hair is pulled into a short topknot at the crown, with smooth sides and a narrow gold band circling the forehead beneath the knot, set with a small round red gemstone above the brows. He wears an era-accurate late 12th-century royal-warrior outfit: a fitted sleeveless quilted cotton tunic in muted deep maroon reaching mid-thigh, fastened diagonally, over which sits a dull-bronze scale vest covering chest and upper back, tied with leather cords. Beneath are cream churidar-style tight trousers with a subtle vertical stripe weave. A long mustard yellow cotton sash wraps firmly around his waist and knots on his left hip, one end hanging to his knee, and a light greyish-blue cotton shoulder scarf (rajapatta) drapes diagonally from one shoulder across the torso, trimmed with a thin maroon and gold geometric border. His forearms have simple brown leather bracers, his hands are bare, and he wears brown leather paduka-like sandals with covered uppers. Jewellery is minimal: small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold bangle on his right wrist, and a flat circular copper pendant on a cord at his neck. His signature weapon is a long Deccan-style gently curved steel sword with a plain iron disc pommel, straight crossguard, and dark brown leather-wrapped grip, held confidently in his right hand with a plain dark leather scabbard hanging from his left hip. Use deep maroon, cream, mustard yellow, dull bronze, and greyish blue as dominant colours, with clean anime linework and a calm, strategic, dignified stance suitable for a historical action series.
